USDe is non-custodial — users retain full control of their assets. Supports liquid staking tokens like wstETH, stETH, and others. Reserves and yield models are regularly audited and reviewed by independent analysts. We participated in the Ethena LP round, which is now closed.

deals.title: Arbitrum Delegation
deals.description: Arbitrum — Scalable Ethereum + Decentralized Governance Arbitrum is a Layer 2 scaling solution for Ethereum, using optimistic rollups to increase transaction speed and reduce gas fees, while maintaining the security guarantees of Ethereum’s base layer. deals.title: Optimism Delegation
deals.description: The Optimism Collective — A New Model of Digital Democratic Governance The Optimism Collective is a new model of digital democratic governance that brings together communities, companies, and citizens. The core principle is impact=profit, meaning that positive impact on the Collective should be rewarded with profit for the individual. In this context, every vote and contribution matters for improving and advancing the ecosystem. Delegating Your Vote In the Optimism Collective system, you have the opportunity to delegate your tokens to others, allowing them to vote on your behalf in governance votes. It is important to note that delegating does not require transferring your tokens, does not lock your funds, or impose any restrictions. Your tokens remain securely in your wallet, and you maintain full control over them. The person you delegate your tokens to gains the ability to vote with them in governance decisions, based on their discretion. This allows you to participate in decision-making without needing to vote in every proposal, but still influencing the collective decisions through your delegated vote. How It Works Delegate your tokens to anyone — you can delegate them to an individual or a group. The delegate receives the ability to vote using your tokens in official governance votes. Your tokens remain in your wallet — you do not lose access to them, and they are not locked. You can revoke your delegation at any time and reassign your vote. Why Delegate? Delegating allows you to: Influence protocol development and decision-making without needing to participate in every vote. Support those you believe are the best candidates or representatives of your community’s interests. Maintain active participation in the Optimism Collective’s democratic process, making it more flexible and accessible to everyone.
deals.preview: Optimism is a Layer 2 solution for Ethereum, using Optimistic Rollups to scale the network, reduce fees, and increase throughput.
